pages.name: Dutch Defense: Stonewall Variation, Chekhover Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed ...g5-g4 into the g5-bishop and traded the bad bishop on a6 with White's bishop on g2; plan 2 was vague about which bishop to trade. Rewrote both plans (reviewer: plan 2 rejected once for saying the f6-knight controls e5, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, 7.Nc3 c6 8.b3 Qe8
pages.notes: Plan 1 lifted the rook via f6 with the knight there; plan 3 traded the bad bishop on a6. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, 7.Nc3 c6 8.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 3 lifted the queen via c2 and e2 (it is on d1); plan 4 gave Black a knight outpost on e5 (Black's is e4). Rewrote plans 3 and 4 (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Stonewall, 7.Nc3 c6 8.Ne5
pages.notes: Plan 2 played Nxf6 with the knight on e5 (it can't reach f6); plan 4 used a knight on f3 that had gone to e5 and called the weaknesses light squares, as did the overview. Rewrote overview and all four plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Classical Variation, Huisl Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 named an e4-pawn that only exists after Nxe4 fxe4 and had Black control e5. Rewrote plan 3.

pages.name: Dutch: Classical, 7.b3 Qe8
pages.notes: Plan 1 lifted the rook via f6 with the knight there and wrote the queen's route ambiguously; plan 3 routed the bishop through the queen on e8. Rewrote plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Dutch: Classical, 7.b3 Qe8 8.Bb2
pages.notes: Plan 2 lifted the rook via f6 with the knight there; plan 1 played Rab1 with the knight on b1. Rewrote plans 1 and 2.

pages.name: Dutch: Classical, 7.Nc3 a5 8.Qc2
pages.notes: Plan 2 lifted the rook via f6 with the knight there and said ...Qe8 controls e4. Rewrote both plans (reviewer: 2 rejected once, Rd1 on a closed d-file and ...Nc6 controlling e4, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Classical, 7.Nc3 a5 8.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted a knight to d6, where Black's pawn stands; plan 3 played around a ...b4 that needs two moves. Rewrote plans 2 and 3 (e2-e4 with the e1-rook recapturing); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Classical Variation, Ilyin-Zhenevsky Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 lifted a rook via f6 and g6 with the knight on f6; plan 3 named White's e4 break in Black's plan. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.
